title: A docker-compose.yml is served
summary: The compose file is downloadable, which names the services, images and often the environment variables the stack runs with.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known.
confirm.differential: status==200 and body_contains("services:") and (body_contains("image:") or body_contains("environment:")) and "html" not in header("content-type") and body_differs(control)

remediate: Keep deployment files out of the web root, and rotate any secrets the file named.
